name: Gowan et al. (2021)
description: A three-parameter radial viscosity structure, prescribed for GIAMIP experiment Exp05, which pairs it with the PaleoMIST ice history from the same authors.

source.citation: Gowan, E. J., Zhang, X., Khosravi, S. et al. (2021). A new global ice sheet reconstruction for the past 80,000 years. Nature Communications 12, 1199. Reproduced in the GIAMIP protocol v2.4, section 3.1.3.

notes: The protocol gives three numbers and no layer boundaries beyond the lithosphere thickness. The depth separating upper from lower mantle is not stated; 670 km is the usual choice and the choice made must be recorded in the model report.
